description: This file defines the interface ProductAttributeDao, which provides methods for accessing product attribute data from the database.

classes.name: ProductAttributeDao
classes.description: Interface for data access operations related to product attributes, extending generic DAO capabilities.

methods.name: getByOptionId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of product attributes associated with a specific merchant store and option ID.

methods.name: getByOptionValueId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of product attributes associated with a specific merchant store and option value ID.

methods.name: getByProduct
methods.description: Retrieves a list of product attributes for a given product within a merchant store, considering the language.

methods.name: getByAttributeIds
methods.description: Retrieves a list of product attributes for given attribute IDs within a merchant store.
